name: Belmonte de Tajo (Spain)
description: Olive yellow field charged at the centre with a rectangle divided vertically, chequy of blue and white at the hoist and a black lion on green at the fly, with green vine leaves in the corners.
history: Municipal flag of Belmonte de Tajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chequy hoist half of the central rectangle
lion rampant on green in the fly half of the rectangle
vine leaves at the upper corners and lower centre
